fields.label: Printful product ID
fields.description: The Printful product this was created from. Edit its design, variants and print files in Printful; the sync adds new variants here and takes removed ones off sale. Name, description, prices and photos are yours to edit in Swell.

extra_actions.label: Sync from Printful
extra_actions.hint: Syncs all your Printful products in the background instead of waiting for the hourly sync.

bulk_actions.label: Resync from Printful
bulk_actions.hint: Re-reads variants from Printful for the selected products, in the background.

modal.title: Resync the selected products?
modal.description: Runs in the background; products that did not come from Printful are skipped.

extra_actions.label: Resync from Printful
extra_actions.hint: Re-reads this product's variants from Printful.

extra_actions.label: Link to Printful product
extra_actions.hint: Prints orders for this product from a product you designed in Printful.

modal.title: Link to a Printful product
modal.description: Orders for this product are printed from the Printful product's design. The product's name, description, prices and photos stay as they are.

fields.label: Printful product ID or link
fields.description: Leave empty to use the Printful product with this product's name.

extra_actions.label: Unlink from Printful
extra_actions.hint: Stops sending orders for this product to Printful.

modal.title: Unlink from Printful?
modal.description: Orders for this product will no longer be sent to Printful. The product itself stays as it is.
